sentences.en: Never choose a new vocation just because you are restless.
sentences.zh: 1.  never choose a new职业 just because you are restless.  never 因为感到不安就选择新的职业。

sentences.en: Never choose a vocation just because the hours are short.
sentences.zh: 2.  never choose a vocation just because the hours are short.  never 因为工作时间短就选择职业。

sentences.en: Never choose a vocation just because it promises social standing.
sentences.zh: 3.  never choose a vocation just because it promises social standing.  never 因为能提升社会地位就选择职业。

senses.zh: 职业，行业；使命，天职；（宗教）圣召
